text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create paintings, compose music, and even write stories or poems. You just give a simple instruction, and the machine produces something new in seconds. However, AI does not truly feel or experience the world. It learns from existing data and finds patterns. Human creativity, on the other hand, comes from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. A machine can copy a style, but it cannot understand why a painting moves us to tears. Perhaps the best results come when humans and AI work together, combining technology with human feeling.
